# Vendored players (MIT)

Runtime copies. The cart Chromebook never hits a CDN.

| File | Package | License | Source pin |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `lottie.min.js` | [lottie-web](https://github.com/airbnb/lottie-web) 5.12.2 | MIT | jsDelivr npm build |
| `confetti.min.js` | [canvas-confetti](https://github.com/catdad/canvas-confetti) 1.9.3 | MIT | jsDelivr browser build |

Swap the JSON in `app/lottie/` for LottieFiles / Lordicon clips (check each file’s
licence; prefer free-for-use). Rive Lucy and Higgsfield trailers are later slots —
see `LOCAL-BUILD.md`. Do not add a `fonts.googleapis` or jsDelivr link to `index.html`.
